title: Timeframe hierarchy
text:
Timeframe hierarchy

Monthly describes the primary trend, weekly its state, daily the immediate structure, and intraday charts additional confirmation.

Course parameters, not execution settings:
{
  "hierarchy": [
    "monthly",
    "weekly",
    "daily",
    "intraday"
  ],
  "intradayExamples": [
    "4h",
    "1h",
    "15m"
  ]
}

Unresolved definitions:
- Minimum history for each timeframe.
- Candle source, session calendar, timezone and close definition.
- Priority when timeframe findings conflict.

title: Trade with the primary trend
text:
Trade with the primary trend

Prefer longs near the lower boundary of an upward channel and shorts near the upper boundary of a downward channel. The larger channel takes priority over internal channels.

Unresolved definitions:
- Pivot and channel detection using only information available at the signal time.
- Minimum contacts and tolerance around a channel boundary.
- Classification of sideways or undetermined trends.

title: Risk on total account equity
text:
Risk on total account equity

The course describes roughly 1% planned account loss for short operations, 2% for swing and up to 4% as an infrequent exception. These are course statements, not approved agent limits.

Course parameters, not execution settings:
{
  "courseRiskBps": {
    "shortOperation": 100,
    "swing": 200,
    "rareException": 400
  },
  "approvedForExecution": false
}

Unresolved definitions:
- Definition of account equity and aggregate risk for correlated positions.
- Reviewed risk limits for an evaluable version.
- Commissions, slippage and funding allowances; planned loss is not a guaranteed realized loss.

title: Leverage and economic exposure
text:
Leverage and economic exposure

The example increases leverage while preserving planned economic exposure and reducing margin used.

Unresolved definitions:
- Deterministic exposure sizing from approved account risk and stop distance.
- Available margin, liquidation constraints and existing creator caps.

title: Retracement and reversal zone
text:
Retracement and reversal zone

The course uses 0.23 for early activation, 0.38 for additional confirmation and 0.61–0.78 as a reversal zone. Each drawing depends on its selected impulse and direction.

Course parameters, not execution settings:
{
  "spokenRatios": [
    "0.23",
    "0.38",
    "0.61",
    "0.78"
  ],
  "spokenReversalZone": [
    "0.61",
    "0.78"
  ],
  "exactRatiosReviewed": false
}

Unresolved definitions:
- Whether spoken ratios are rounded or exact.
- Reproducible impulse and retracement anchors, orientation and formula.
- Confirmation by price cross, candle close or persistence.

title: Reversal with the primary trend
text:
Reversal with the primary trend

The practical setup combines weekly trend and channel, correction or rebound toward the relevant boundary, and the previous impulse reversal zone. Phi and mother wave can reinforce the scenario.

Course parameters, not execution settings:
{
  "phiMandatoryInCourseBasicSetup": false,
  "motherWaveMandatoryInCourseBasicSetup": false
}

Unresolved definitions:
- Required versus optional confluences for the first version.
- Maximum distance to the relevant channel boundary.
- Separate upward and downward variants without mixing Fibonacci drawings.

title: Earlier or more confirmed entry
text:
Earlier or more confirmed entry

The course describes entry through 0.23 and an alternative with additional confirmation through 0.38.

Course parameters, not execution settings:
{
  "spokenEntryAlternatives": [
    "0.23",
    "0.38"
  ],
  "selectedEntryRatio": null
}

Unresolved definitions:
- One reviewed entry mode or explicit rules for both alternatives.
- Trigger freshness, order semantics and expiration.
- Use only a crossing that has already occurred.

title: Structural stop
text:
Structural stop

Stop placement follows the selected pattern extreme or reversal-zone invalidation. The course does not supply one universal fixed percentage distance.

Course parameters, not execution settings:
{
  "fixedUniversalStopBps": null
}

Unresolved definitions:
- Selection among alternative invalidation anchors.
- Tick or volatility buffer and liquidation constraints.
- A possible sweep cannot authorize widening a stop or bypassing host controls.

title: Move the stop toward entry
Staged targets and partial exits
text:
Staged targets and partial exits

Initial targets are 0.61 and 0.78, followed by 1.00, 1.27 and 1.61 in confirmed extensions, with 2.61 in more extended scenarios. A lesson offers partial exits of 15% or 20%.

Course parameters, not execution settings:
{
  "spokenInitialTargets": [
    "0.61",
    "0.78"
  ],
  "spokenExtendedTargets": [
    "1.00",
    "1.27",
    "1.61",
    "2.61"
  ],
  "spokenPartialAlternativesBps": [
    1500,
    2000
  ],
  "threeAnchorExtensionTargets": [
    "2.61",
    "3.61",
    "4.61"
  ],
  "selectedPartialSchedule": null
}

Unresolved definitions:
- Partial percentages, initial versus remaining quantity and final remainder.
- Conditions authorizing extended targets and the correct drawing.
- Event ordering when stop and target appear in the same candle.

title: Breakout and sweep confirmation
text:
Breakout and sweep confirmation

Different lessons discuss quick recovery and 24–72 hour windows for different structures. The text does not establish one timer for all timeframes.

Course parameters, not execution settings:
{
  "mentionedHours": [
    24,
    48,
    72
  ],
  "selectedUniversalHours": null
}

Unresolved definitions:
- Confirmation matrix by timeframe and structure.
- Calendar hours versus sessions or closed candles.
- Initial detection versus later confirmation.

title: Mother wave
text:
Mother wave

An approximately complete retracement to 1.00 occurs within a larger valid trend. A subsequent movement through 0.23 or 0.38 supplies confirmation.

Course parameters, not execution settings:
{
  "spokenOriginRetracementRatio": "1.00",
  "spokenEntryAlternatives": [
    "0.23",
    "0.38"
  ]
}

Unresolved definitions:
- Tolerance around return to the origin.
- Confirmed anchors and activation time.
- Maximum number of candles and formation duration.

title: Phi pattern
text:
Phi pattern

The course describes an extension into 1.27–1.61 and subsequent reversal confirmation through 0.23 or 0.38, preferably aligned with the larger trend.

Course parameters, not execution settings:
{
  "spokenExtensionZone": [
    "1.27",
    "1.61"
  ],
  "spokenEntryAlternatives": [
    "0.23",
    "0.38"
  ]
}

Unresolved definitions:
- Exact geometry and sequence of pattern points.
- Tolerance for breaches and zone width.
- Separate a candidate pattern from a confirmed pattern.

title: Phi followed by a mother wave
text:
Phi followed by a mother wave

A mother wave after Phi reinforces the scenario. Examples include multiple waves and alternative stop anchors.

Unresolved definitions:
- Which wave confirms the scenario and how many are allowed.
- Required components for a selected first variant.
- Human-reviewed positive and negative labeled examples.

title: Failed triangle
text:
Failed triangle

After a break in the prior trend direction, price returns toward the vertex and confirms in the opposite direction. The course calls this triángulo reventado.

Unresolved definitions:
- Triangle and vertex detection.
- Return tolerance, crossing and confirmation window.
- Separate use as an exit warning from use as a new entry.

title: Phi wedge
text:
Phi wedge

A wedge combines with Phi, sometimes also a mother wave, and confirms through 0.23 or 0.38.

Course parameters, not execution settings:
{
  "spokenEntryAlternatives": [
    "0.23",
    "0.38"
  ]
}

Unresolved definitions:
- Measurable slopes and convergence.
- Minimum contacts and amplitude.
- Reviewed positive and negative examples.

title: Leading diagonal as defined by PTS
text:
Leading diagonal as defined by PTS

An initially opposing wedge reverses with Phi or a mother wave. The upward variant breaks the previous high; the downward variant breaks the previous low.

Course parameters, not execution settings:
{
  "definitionNamespace": "pts-course"
}

Unresolved definitions:
- Preserve the course-specific definition rather than substitute a homonymous pattern.
- Definition of the preceding extreme and sequence.
- The provided lesson ends mid-sentence.

title: Seller covering
text:
Seller covering

The 2.61 extension of a bearish mother wave is described as a potential bounce or turn area, not a universal immediate entry.

Course parameters, not execution settings:
{
  "spokenPotentialZoneRatio": "2.61"
}

Unresolved definitions:
- Tolerance around 2.61.
- Additional entry confirmation.
- Separate a temporary bounce from a larger trend change.

title: Continuation in intermediate ranges
text:
Continuation in intermediate ranges

The course seeks intraday opportunities in macro impulse ranges 0.38–0.61 and above 0.78, treating 0.61–0.78 as less favorable for these continuation entries.

Course parameters, not execution settings:
{
  "spokenContinuationRange": [
    "0.38",
    "0.61"
  ],
  "spokenExtendedThreshold": "0.78"
}

Unresolved definitions:
- Macro impulse ranges versus local pattern triggers.
- Keep correction reversal zones separate from new impulse targets.
- An independently reviewed horizon for continuation setups.
